_note: 學習路徑內容建置第5批 #5／6：關係副詞 when/where/why（eng.t_adv.relcl.relative-adverb，學測級／高階）。when 接時間名詞（the day when）、where 接地點名詞（the town where）、why 接 the reason（the reason why）；關係副詞＝介系詞＋which（where＝in/at which）；地點當動詞受詞時用 that/which 不用 where（the museum that we visited）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rla_）。

units.can_do: 我能用關係副詞連接子句——when 接時間名詞（the day when we met）、where 接地點名詞（the town where I grew up）、why 接 the reason（the reason why）——並分辨：地點是「動作發生的地方」用 where，地點是動詞的受詞時用 that/which。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'when' is a relative adverb used after a noun of time (day, year, moment, season) to join a clause: I remember the day when we met. Summer is the season when we go swimming.
claims.verification_ref: when 接時間名詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'where' is used after a noun of place (house, city, school, park) to say where something happens: This is the town where I grew up. That's the park where we play soccer.
claims.verification_ref: where 接地點名詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'why' is used after the word 'reason' to give the reason for something: Tell me the reason why you are late. That is the reason why she left.
claims.verification_ref: why 接 the reason；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A relative adverb (where/when) replaces 'preposition + which'; use 'where' for a place where an action happens (the house where I live = the house in which I live), but use 'that/which' when the place is the object of the verb (the museum that we visited).
claims.verification_ref: where＝介系詞+which；地點當受詞時用 that/which；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The relative adverbs when, where, and why join a clause to a noun to tell us the time, the place, or the reason. Use when after a time noun (the day, the year, the season).
teach.zh_hint: 關係副詞 when／where／why 用來把一個子句接到名詞後面，說明「什麼時候／在哪裡／為什麼」。when 接時間名詞（the day、the year、the season）。

teach.body: I will never forget the day when we first met.
teach.zh_hint: 我永遠不會忘記我們初次相遇的那天。時間名詞 the day ＋ when。

teach.body: Use where after a place noun (the house, the city, the school) to show where something happens, and use why after 'the reason' to show the cause.
teach.zh_hint: where 接地點名詞（the house、the city、the school），說明事情發生的地方；why 接 the reason，說明原因。

teach.body: This is the restaurant where we had dinner. Tell me the reason why you left.
teach.zh_hint: 這就是我們吃晚餐的餐廳。告訴我你離開的原因。地點＋where、the reason＋why。

teach.body: A quick note: where means 'preposition + which' (the house where I live = the house in which I live). But if the place is the object of a verb (in 'visit the museum', museum is the object of visit), use that or which, not where.
teach.zh_hint: 小提醒：where＝「介系詞＋which」（the house where I live＝the house in which I live）。但如果地點是動詞的受詞（例如 visit the museum，museum 是 visit 的受詞），就要用 that／which，不用 where。

teach.body: The school where I study is near my home.
teach.zh_hint: 我讀書的那所學校離我家很近。study 在學校裡發生，用 where＝at which。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係副詞：Summer is the season ____ we go swimming.（夏天是我們去游泳的季節。）

distractor_rationales.where: season 是時間不是地點；時間名詞要用 when。
distractor_rationales.why: why 用在 the reason 之後；這裡是時間，用 when。
distractor_rationales.which: the season which we go swimming 少了介系詞不通；時間用關係副詞 when。

practice.feedback: 時間名詞 season 後用 when：the season when we go swimming。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係副詞：That's the park ____ we play soccer every weekend.（那是我們每個週末踢足球的公園。）

distractor_rationales.when: park 是地點不是時間；地點名詞要用 where。
distractor_rationales.which: the park which we play soccer 少了介系詞不通；動作發生地點用 where。
distractor_rationales.why: why 用在 the reason 之後；這裡是地點，用 where。

practice.feedback: 動作發生的地點用 where：the park where we play soccer。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係副詞：Can you tell me the reason ____ you were absent?（你可以告訴我你缺席的原因嗎？）

distractor_rationales.where: where 接地點；the reason 後面要用 why。
distractor_rationales.when: when 接時間；the reason 後面要用 why。
distractor_rationales.how: the reason 後面的關係副詞是 why，不是 how。

practice.feedback: the reason 後用 why：the reason why you were absent。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係詞：This is the house ____ I was born.（這就是我出生的房子。）

distractor_rationales.which: the house which I was born 少了介系詞（in which）不通；動作發生地點用 where。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人；房子要用 where。
distractor_rationales.when: when 接時間；房子是地點，用 where。

practice.feedback: 出生「在」房子裡（where＝in which）：the house where I was born。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係詞：This is the museum ____ we visited on our trip.（這就是我們旅途中參觀的博物館。注意 visit 是及物動詞，museum 是它的受詞。）

distractor_rationales.where: visit 是及物動詞、museum 是它的受詞（visit the museum），不是「動作發生的地方」，所以用 that/which，不用 where。
distractor_rationales.when: when 接時間；這裡是地點名詞的受詞，用 that。
distractor_rationales.why: why 用在 the reason 之後；這裡要用 that。

practice.feedback: 地點是動詞的受詞（visited the museum）時用 that/which，不用 where：the museum that we visited。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I still remember the summer when we visited the village where my grandmother was born.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：the summer when（時間）和 the village where（地點）有沒有用對關係副詞，拼字和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。關係副詞 when／where 輕讀、不特別重音；兩句句尾自然下收。

lines.text: This is the house where I grew up.
lines.intonation: 平穩、house 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: I'll never forget the day when we met.
lines.intonation: 平穩、never／day 稍強調、句尾下收
